name: SikaControl® PLUS
summary: SikaControl® PLUS is a shrinkage-reducing admixture used to produce high performance concrete with greatly reduced drying shrinkage.
metaDescription: SikaControl® PLUS is a shrinkage-reducing admixture used to produce high performance concrete with greatly reduced drying shrinkage.
attributes: Reduction in the potential for drying shrinkage cracking.
Reduces the potential for slab curling.
Substantially reduces the occurrence of drying shrinkage cracks and therefore reduces permeability, resulting in improved concrete durability.
usage: In premixed and precast concrete elements to reduce the drying shrinkage of the concrete.
In thin bonded topping slabs, to minimise the difference in shrinkage between the new topping and the existing substrate.
In concrete elements which are restrained against shrinkage.
For durable concrete in marine environments.
For watertight concrete in reservoirs, sewage treatment plants, dams.
advantages: Reduction in the potential for drying shrinkage cracking.
Reduces the potential for slab curling.
Substantially reduces the occurrence of drying shrinkage cracks and therefore reduces permeability, resulting in improved concrete durability.
packaging: Bulk deliveries 1000 litre IBC 205 litre drum 10 litre container

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: SikaControl® PLUS meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 as Special Purpose Admixture Type (SN).

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight , shelf life is at least one (1) year.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from direct sunlight.

items.label: Dispensing
items.text: The required dosage of SikaControl® PLUS should be added to the concrete at the batching plant, with the gauging water or poured into the concrete simultaneously with the gauging water. It may also be added into the transit mixer at the point of discharge, but an additional mixing time of 60 seconds/m3 is required and the concrete should be visually checked for uniform consistency.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
SikaControl® PLUS is compatible with other Sika Concrete admixtures, however, they must be added separately.
Do not pre-mix SikaControl® PLUS with other admixtures, and always conduct trials to test compatibility.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text:
Typical dosage rate is 1.0 – 3.0% by weight of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage depends on specified requirements, mix ingredients and required plastic and hardened properties.
Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
